node.statement: The remaining sum is bounded by the halo bookkeeping: because distances H_j are nonnegative, notin G is exactly B union Z with B={0<H_j<=tau/4} and Z={H_j=0}. Node 1.1.3 gives H_j<=tau/4 on B and H_j=0 on Z, and a_j^+>=0. Hence sum_{j notin G}a_j^+H_j=sum_{j in B}a_j^+H_j+sum_{j in Z}a_j^+H_j<= (tau/4)*sum_{j in B}a_j^+. Node 1.1.2 gives sum_{j in B}a_j^+=sigma-sigma_g, so sum_{j notin G}a_j^+H_j <= (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4.
